newsitem.title: USA: Artra Group unit cited in pollution probe.
newsitem.headline: Artra Group unit cited in pollution probe.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said Thursday it filed an administrative complaint against Artra Group Inc's Bagcraft Corp of America division for alleged violations of the Clean Air Act.
The agency said a Bagcraft plant in Chicago produced volatile organic materials that contributed to the formation of ground-level ozone above local standards.
The EPA has proposed a $250,000 civil penalty. Bagcraft has 30 days to file an answer to the proposal and to request a formal hearing, the EPA said.
Artra Group shares were unchanged Thursday at 4-3/4.
